scripts.dev: bun run audio && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: bun run audio && bun run captions && remotion render src/index.ts LaunchLight2D out/wrapper-launch.mp4 && remotion render src/index.ts LaunchVerticalLight2D out/wrapper-launch-vertical.mp4
scripts.render:4k: bun run audio && remotion render src/index.ts LaunchLight2D out/wrapper-launch-4k.mp4 --scale=2
scripts.render:all: bun run audio && bun run captions && for id in Launch LaunchVertical LaunchLight LaunchVerticalLight Launch2D LaunchVertical2D LaunchLight2D LaunchVerticalLight2D; do remotion render src/index.ts $id out/all/$id.mp4 || exit 1; done
